text:
The vote, undertaken by way of a roll call, was carried. The votes were recorded as follows:

For the Motion: Councillors Jon Harvey, Michelle Bateman, Alistair Cameron, Tessa Hodgson, Rhys Sinnett, Marc Tierney, Jacob Williams and Guy Woodham [8]

There were no votes against or abstentions.

(b) That the Council proceed under section 35 Road Traffic Regulations Act 1984 (“1984 Act”) to make an order, subject to the specific requirements of the 1984 Act and relevant regulations, to vary the Pembrokeshire County Council (Off-Street Parking Places) (Consolidation) Order 2011 to:

(i) Vary the charges and charging period at Haverfordwest Interchange, introduce 1 hour £0.00 tariff and dedicated motorbike bays with an associated charge. The specific charges are set out in the table under 3.2 above;

(ii) Vary the charges for Tenby Harbour permits as detailed below:

(d) That the proposal to undertake a full review of parking services operations to include parking charges, charging periods, seasonal charges, license opportunities, in line with full cost recovery be noted, and a report be brought back to Cabinet in June 2027 – any changes be implemented from September 2027.

Reason for Decisions: To comply with the Authority’s Constitution, ensure the Council is able to meet its statutory duties in relation to Education Transport and that training courses are funded on a cost recovery basis.
